notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA Maine list gives only county, coordinates and gone; the record has no register number and no FFLOS or NHLR page exists in the caches (firetower.org guessed slug returned 404). The story is general Maine lookout context plus the status line, so it is below the usual 120-word floor; no tower-specific build, staffing, fate or site facts were found. Digital Maine has no map for this tower in its index pages read. Facebook FFLA Maine chapter posts were seen only as search snippets (login shell on fetch), so not used. Suggested next search: Maine Memory and newspaper archives under the mountain name, and Somerset County records. Two websearch.py queries used.
